create_equivariance_widget: create an EquivarianceWidget instance with a viz object to control translation and rotation
call_equivariance_widget_ui: call the EquivarianceWidget to render the ImGui translate and rotate control UI
configure_translation_animation: configure the EquivarianceWidget xlate animation speed and round options for smooth translation
configure_rotation_animation: configure the EquivarianceWidget rotate animation speed for continuous rotation control
compute_input_transform_matrix: compute the 3x3 affine input_transform matrix from translation and rotation values
